notes.title: USELESS BOX: THE GAME v1.1 UPDATE
notes.notes:
Useless Box: The Game has been updated to v1.1, a microscopic update.


 Fixed completion percent counter.  Those who had tried to complete the game to 100% will now be able to.
 Small feature update to the counter.  It now hides itself when you access the game settings.  This was to prevent overlapping UI if count numbers got too high.
 Removed spooky ghost!
 Game price update!
